trai-network-anubhav-user-speed-map-guid.heading: Official launch photographs
trai-network-anubhav-user-speed-map-guid.intro: TRAI published these photographs from the Network Anubhav launch on 4 November 2026. They show the launch event, not our testing of mobile networks.
